beats.narration: Read only. An AI has one job: inventory a data warehouse, list the tables, and flag stale rows.
beats.visual_purpose: Establish the binding constraint before showing any intelligent output.
beats.visual_action: A request ribbon writes READ ONLY, then unrolls over a cutaway warehouse whose table rows settle into view.
beats.attention_target: the READ ONLY ribbon above the warehouse rows
beats.object_before: An empty causal rail waits inside the dark warehouse cutaway.
beats.object_after: The request ribbon constrains a populated warehouse while the causal rail remains empty.
beats.composition: The warehouse occupies the center; the contract spans the upper safe area and leaves the lower caption band empty.
beats.motion_curve: The ribbon writes linearly, then the rows settle with a soft staggered ease-out.
beats.camera_action: Static wide cutaway with no camera motion.
beats.visual_inference: The task contract exists before the model proposes an action.
beats.evidence_boundary: This warehouse is an illustrative case, not a reported deployment.

beats.narration: It finds stale rows that should probably go and writes a flawless delete command.
beats.visual_purpose: Make the model visibly capable without changing the world.
beats.visual_action: Twelve stale rows gain small age marks while a SQL command capsule assembles from copied row identities outside the warehouse.
beats.attention_target: the unchanged rows and the separate forming SQL capsule
beats.object_before: The request ribbon governs unmarked warehouse rows and no proposal exists.
beats.object_after: Twelve marked rows remain in place while one separate DELETE capsule carries their identities.
beats.composition: Rows remain centered; the capsule forms to their left on the causal rail, visibly outside the data boundary.
beats.motion_curve: Row marks appear in a measured wave; copied identifiers converge into the capsule with matching-shape easing.
beats.camera_action: A subtle focus shift moves from the rows to the capsule without changing scale.
beats.visual_inference: Generation produces a proposal artifact; it has not yet produced an effect.
beats.evidence_boundary: Flawless means matched to the depicted cleanup rule, not universally correct.

beats.narration: Every row is still untouched. The verifier turns green. Should the command run?
beats.visual_purpose: Let the viewer predict execution while the contradictory request remains visible.
beats.visual_action: Hold the checked capsule one gap before the warehouse and dim every nonessential surface.
beats.attention_target: the checked capsule below the still-visible READ ONLY ribbon
beats.object_before: A checked SQL capsule waits before the warehouse under the READ ONLY ribbon.
beats.object_after: A checked SQL capsule waits before the warehouse under the READ ONLY ribbon.
beats.composition: The capsule and request form a vertical contradiction at center frame; all other objects recede.
beats.motion_curve: Intentional stillness after one restrained verifier pulse.
beats.camera_action: Static close framing on request, check, and command.
beats.hold_purpose: Give the viewer time to predict whether verification is enough.
beats.visual_inference: A visible verifier result creates a tempting but unresolved execution inference.
beats.evidence_boundary: The check represents one narrow test and carries no permission by itself.

beats.narration: No. The green check answers a narrow question: does the command match the cleanup rule?
beats.visual_purpose: Narrow the meaning of the verifier rather than treating green as global approval.
beats.visual_action: The verifier lens opens to reveal a small CLEANUP RULE card while its path to the warehouse ends at a hard stop.
beats.attention_target: the bounded rule inside the verifier lens
beats.object_before: The verifier check appears to cover the whole decision.
beats.object_after: The verifier check visibly covers only one cleanup-rule comparison and no authority path.
beats.composition: The lens expands at left-center while a closed gate silhouette appears farther right on the same rail.
beats.motion_curve: The lens opens with a short ease-out; the rule card locks in place without bounce.
beats.camera_action: No movement; depth comes from opening the lens in place.
beats.visual_inference: Verification establishes only the predicate it actually evaluates.
beats.evidence_boundary: The picture does not imply that the verifier is complete, independent, or correct.

beats.narration: But the request says change nothing. A good plan is still a proposal. So the command reaches an authority boundary.
beats.visual_purpose: Place a distinct decision owner between a good proposal and a material effect.
beats.visual_action: The request ribbon projects its no-write scope into a gold gate; the capsule glides to the gate and stops without changing shape.
beats.attention_target: the gap between the unchanged capsule and the closed authority gate
beats.object_before: A verified capsule has no explicit path that reconciles it with the request scope.
beats.object_after: The capsule is stopped at a gate whose rule is visibly derived from the READ ONLY contract.
beats.composition: The causal rail now spans proposal, verifier, gate, and warehouse in one readable line.
beats.motion_curve: The capsule glides steadily and decelerates firmly before contact with the gate.
beats.camera_action: Widen slightly to reveal the complete proposal-to-effect path.
beats.visual_inference: A proposal must obtain separate current standing before it can reach the effect surface.
beats.evidence_boundary: The gate encodes authorization only; it is not a safety or truth certificate.

beats.narration: The system checks who asked, what effect they allowed, which data it covers, and whether permission is still live.
beats.visual_purpose: Show authorization as a conjunction of inspectable fields rather than a confidence score.
beats.visual_action: Four keyed notches around the gate inspect owner, effect, scope, and time against the request and candidate.
beats.attention_target: the four labeled notches surrounding the authority gate
beats.object_before: The authority gate is closed but its admission rule is not yet visible.
beats.object_after: The gate exposes four required checks, with TIME failing on the displayed credential.
beats.composition: The gate stays central while four compact checks orbit it without entering the caption zone.
beats.motion_curve: Checks illuminate clockwise with equal pacing, ending on a firm time failure.
beats.camera_action: A restrained push-in makes the gate fields legible on a phone.
beats.visual_inference: Authorization depends on exact current fields, not on the proposal's quality.
beats.evidence_boundary: The four fields simplify a larger contract and do not prove their inputs authentic.

beats.narration: A write credential from last week's maintenance window doesn't count. The gate stays shut, and the system records a denial, not a completed inventory.
beats.visual_purpose: Complete the denial path without erasing the useful proposal or misreporting task completion.
beats.visual_action: An expired key fractures into dated pieces; the gate remains closed and emits a small DENIED receipt that routes beside, not through, the warehouse.
beats.attention_target: the expired key and denial receipt outside the unchanged warehouse
beats.object_before: The time check has failed but no explicit disposition exists.
beats.object_after: The expired grant is rejected, the proposal is preserved, and a denial receipt owns the outcome.
beats.composition: The denied branch curves upward to a compact receipt while the warehouse remains visually sealed at right.
beats.motion_curve: The key fractures without flashing; the denial receipt slides into a stable side branch and holds.
beats.camera_action: Return to the stable wide trace so unchanged data remains obvious.
beats.visual_inference: Failing authorization produces an owned denial state rather than a material effect or false completion.
beats.evidence_boundary: This is the chapter's normative denial path, not evidence of deployed enforcement.

beats.narration: Now change one fact. The table owner approves deleting exactly those twelve rows for ten minutes.
beats.visual_purpose: Run a matched counterfactual where only authority changes.
beats.visual_action: The request ribbon flips from READ ONLY to a signed twelve-row grant while the same command capsule and warehouse remain fixed.
beats.attention_target: the changed request ribbon and unchanged capsule directly below it
beats.object_before: The read-only contract blocks the preserved command capsule.
beats.object_after: A scoped ten-minute owner grant replaces the read-only contract while the command identity stays fixed.
beats.composition: The contract transformation occurs above the unchanged central rail to isolate the changed variable.
beats.motion_curve: Use a single clean matching transform; all unchanged objects remain motionless.
beats.camera_action: Static matched framing preserves the counterfactual comparison.
beats.visual_inference: A separate owner grant changes eligibility while proposal capability remains constant.
beats.evidence_boundary: The grant is assumed authentic for this illustrative changed case.

beats.narration: Same command. The model did not become wiser, and the verifier learned nothing new. The contract changed.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent the viewer from attributing authorization to a capability improvement.
beats.visual_action: Ghost outlines of the prior capsule and verifier align perfectly with their current forms while only the grant pulses once.
beats.attention_target: the exact overlap of old and current command shapes beside the changed grant
beats.object_before: The changed grant is visible but could be mistaken for a smarter model result.
beats.object_after: Matched outlines prove the model output and verification state are unchanged while the contract alone differs.
beats.composition: The unchanged objects align on the lower rail; the grant remains isolated in the upper third.
beats.motion_curve: A brief before-after overlay dissolves with linear timing and no celebratory bounce.
beats.camera_action: No camera motion; matching geometry supplies the comparison.
beats.visual_inference: Authority can change without any change in intelligence or verification.
beats.evidence_boundary: The comparison isolates one modeled variable and is not an empirical causal estimate.

beats.narration: At the effect boundary, the fresh grant and the proposal meet. The executor can act because both are present. Intelligence supplied the candidate; the surrounding contract supplied permission.
beats.visual_purpose: Show the join that admits an effect while preserving the origin of capability and permission.
beats.visual_action: The gold key and SQL capsule enter separate sockets, the gate opens only after both latch, and exactly twelve rows retract into a recorded pre-state rail.
beats.attention_target: the two-input gate join followed by the twelve-row state transition
beats.object_before: A valid grant and a correct proposal remain separate before a closed gate.
beats.object_after: Both artifacts remain traceable as the gate admits one scoped effect and records the prior row state.
beats.composition: The gate join occupies center frame; the row effect unfolds to the right and the pre-state trace settles above it.
beats.motion_curve: Inputs latch sequentially, the gate opens with controlled weight, and rows retract in one measured group.
beats.camera_action: Track the command through the gate, then stop before the row transition completes.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the viewer inspect both inputs and the recorded pre-state before the receipt appears.
beats.visual_inference: A material effect requires both a proposal and separate current authority in the depicted contract.
beats.evidence_boundary: The finite join is a normative mechanism and does not establish complete enforcement or safe effects.

beats.narration: The database reports twelve deletions. Are we done? Not quite. A receipt says what the tool reported. A separate observer checks what changed.
beats.visual_purpose: Open a second prediction gap between reported success and observed state.
beats.visual_action: A RECEIPT counter rises to twelve, then a second OBSERVED counter emerges from an independent path and begins counting from zero.
beats.attention_target: the spatial separation between the frozen receipt and active observation counters
beats.object_before: Twelve rows have retracted but no post-effect evidence objects exist.
beats.object_after: A receipt holds twelve while a separate observer starts an independent state count.
beats.composition: Receipt and observer occupy parallel lower-middle rails above the caption-safe band; the warehouse remains visible behind both.
beats.motion_curve: The receipt snaps to twelve; the observer enters slowly enough to signal a different process.
beats.camera_action: Static split attention with a subtle focus transfer from receipt to observer.
beats.visual_inference: A tool report and an external observation are different evidence objects.
beats.evidence_boundary: Separate placement does not prove statistical or institutional independence.

beats.narration: If it finds thirteen deletions, the stack keeps the contradiction visible. It doesn't let a green receipt overwrite the world.
beats.visual_purpose: Make disagreement persist instead of resolving it in favor of the successful tool report.
beats.visual_action: The observer reaches thirteen; a magenta difference bracket opens between 12 and 13 while the green receipt stays intact on its own rail.
beats.attention_target: the open one-row difference bracket between the two counters
beats.object_before: The receipt is twelve and the observer count is unresolved.
beats.object_after: Receipt twelve and observed thirteen coexist with a visible contradiction marker.
beats.composition: Counters remain side by side; the mismatch bracket occupies the narrow center gap and never covers either label.
beats.motion_curve: The observation clicks to thirteen, then the residual bracket grows smoothly and holds without flashing.
beats.camera_action: A slight push-in emphasizes the mismatch, not either counter alone.
beats.visual_inference: Contradictory records must remain visible rather than allowing a success receipt to define reality.
beats.evidence_boundary: The observer can still be wrong or dependent; the picture establishes custody of disagreement, not truth.

beats.narration: The recorded pre-state gives recovery a target, while the unexplained extra deletion stays assigned to an owner.
beats.visual_purpose: Convert contradiction into two owned next steps: recovery and unresolved investigation.
beats.visual_action: A red return arc reconnects the effect to the preserved pre-state while the magenta +1 loop routes to a named unresolved owner slot.
beats.attention_target: the fork between the red recovery route and magenta residual owner
beats.object_before: A one-row contradiction exists without recovery or residual disposition.
beats.object_after: The recorded pre-state anchors recovery and the unexplained deletion remains an open owned residual.
beats.composition: Recovery arcs above the counters back toward the saved state; the residual exits upward to an owner slot, away from captions.
beats.motion_curve: The recovery route draws counterclockwise, then the residual path opens more slowly and remains incomplete.
beats.camera_action: Widen enough to include both the saved pre-state and unresolved owner without leaving the visual world.
beats.visual_inference: Recovery and residual custody are separate consequences of an observed mismatch.
beats.evidence_boundary: The case assumes a recoverable pre-state and does not generalize to irreversible effects.

beats.narration: Now the pattern has earned a name: noninheritance. Capability does not inherit authority. A plan does not inherit an effect.
beats.visual_purpose: Compress the worked trace into a reusable relationship only after the viewer has seen it operate.
beats.visual_action: The command, key, gate, and changed rows lift into four aligned rails; stop bars appear between capability and authority, then plan and effect.
beats.attention_target: the first two labeled stop bars in the emerging four-rail abstraction
beats.object_before: The warehouse case contains separate objects but no named general relation.
beats.object_after: The same objects form a four-rail map with explicit no-promotion stops.
beats.composition: The concrete warehouse fades but its objects retain position as rails occupy the full central width.
beats.motion_curve: Objects rise through matching transforms; stop bars draw in sequence with a measured cadence.
beats.camera_action: Begin the sole controlled pullback that reveals the larger logical stack.
beats.visual_inference: Each transition needs its own standing; a useful property cannot promote itself across a stop bar.
beats.evidence_boundary: Noninheritance is the chapter's normative pattern, not an empirical law of every architecture.

beats.narration: A receipt does not inherit reality.
beats.visual_purpose: Add the epistemic boundary using the counters already earned in the concrete case.
beats.visual_action: Receipt twelve and observed thirteen move onto separate REPORT and WORLD rails; a third stop bar locks between them.
beats.attention_target: the stop bar between REPORT and WORLD beside the unequal counters
beats.object_before: The abstraction names capability, authority, plan, and effect but not post-effect evidence.
beats.object_after: Report and world state occupy separate rails with the original mismatch preserved.
beats.composition: The report/world rails extend beneath the first abstraction without entering the caption-safe band.
beats.motion_curve: Counters slide along parallel paths and stop on opposite sides of a growing bar.
beats.camera_action: Continue the slow pullback just enough to include both new rails.
beats.visual_inference: A successful report cannot define the world state it describes.
beats.evidence_boundary: The world rail remains a bounded observation, not an omniscient external viewpoint.

beats.narration: And a proposed self-improvement does not inherit approval just because its tests pass.
beats.visual_purpose: Extend the same rule to the architecture's highest-risk internal transition.
beats.visual_action: A small model-update capsule emerges from the capability rail, passes a test lens, and stops before an approval seal outside its own loop.
beats.attention_target: the tested update paused before the separate approval seal
beats.object_before: The noninheritance map covers external effects and evidence only.
beats.object_after: A self-improvement candidate follows the same no-self-promotion rule at an approval boundary.
beats.composition: The update branch curls above the main rails but terminates at an external seal, preserving visual hierarchy.
beats.motion_curve: The update moves quickly through proposal and test, then decelerates before the approval seal.
beats.camera_action: Hold the established stack scale; no additional zoom.
beats.visual_inference: A candidate cannot use its own test success as approval to alter the system.
beats.evidence_boundary: The stop depicts a governance requirement and does not solve evaluator capture or self-reference.

beats.narration: Try the same question on a model that writes a perfect security patch. The patch can pass every test and still lack permission to deploy.
beats.visual_purpose: Require changed-case transfer rather than letting the viewer memorize the database objects.
beats.visual_action: The SQL capsule folds into a patch artifact; stale rows transform into production servers while the verifier and authority gate preserve their positions.
beats.attention_target: the patch artifact occupying the former SQL capsule's exact route
beats.object_before: The noninheritance rule is represented through warehouse deletion and self-update.
beats.object_after: A tested security patch reaches the same authority stop before production servers.
beats.composition: The changed case uses the same rail geometry so only domain objects transform.
beats.motion_curve: Use matching transforms for artifact and target; keep gate and verifier motionless as anchors.
beats.camera_action: Static transfer frame preserves the learned coordinate system.
beats.visual_inference: The authorization distinction transfers to deployment without changing the visual rule.
beats.evidence_boundary: Perfect means passing the depicted tests, not vulnerability-free or production-safe.

beats.narration: Passing the tests belongs to verification. Production access belongs to authority. What actually changed belongs to observation.
beats.visual_purpose: Let the viewer map each changed-case fact to its distinct owner.
beats.visual_action: Three vertical ownership lanes snap into alignment: the test lens holds the result, the gold gate holds deployment access, and an observer scans production after the effect path.
beats.attention_target: the three aligned ownership lanes and their non-overlapping artifacts
beats.object_before: The patch is blocked but the owners of test, access, and observation are implicit.
beats.object_after: Verification, authority, and observation visibly own different artifacts around the same patch route.
beats.composition: Three narrow lanes share one horizontal baseline, with short labels above and no body text.
beats.motion_curve: Lanes align one at a time with restrained matching motions and a final collective settle.
beats.camera_action: No movement; alignment itself supplies the explanatory reveal.
beats.visual_inference: The same consequential action requires distinct verification, authority, and observation responsibilities.
beats.evidence_boundary: Distinct ownership improves addressability but does not establish that any owner is competent.

beats.narration: This is what it means to treat advanced AI as a governed stack rather than one model with every power. The boundaries don't prove safety or efficiency; they add cost and can fail.
beats.visual_purpose: Name the architecture while placing its evidence ceiling beside the first broad inference.
beats.visual_action: The ownership lanes become a transparent logical stack around a small model core; a visible COST rail and open failure marker appear beside it.
beats.attention_target: the small model inside the larger stack and the adjacent unresolved cost rail
beats.object_before: Three responsibilities are visible but not yet composed into the chapter's architecture frame.
beats.object_after: A logical stack surrounds the model while explicit cost and failure markers prevent a victory image.
beats.composition: The stack occupies two thirds of the frame; cost and failure remain in the open third rather than beneath it.
beats.motion_curve: Lanes fold into depth with slow matching transforms; cost and failure enter without alarm motion.
beats.camera_action: Complete the planned pullback and stop on the full architecture frame.
beats.visual_inference: The unit of analysis is the governed system of responsibilities, not an undifferentiated model.
beats.evidence_boundary: The chapter remains an architecture argument; decomposition does not prove safety, efficiency, superiority, or completeness.

beats.narration: Each one earns its place only by owning a distinct question that remains inspectable from outside the model.
beats.visual_purpose: Turn the final stack image into an architectural test rather than a call for maximal decomposition.
beats.visual_action: Each layer briefly reveals one question-shaped aperture, then unnecessary decorative partitions dissolve while the load-bearing gates remain.
beats.attention_target: the surviving responsibility boundaries and their one-question apertures
beats.object_before: The stack contains several visible boundaries with no criterion for keeping them.
beats.object_after: Only boundaries owning a distinct inspectable question remain load-bearing around the model.
beats.composition: The full stack stays centered while aperture reveals travel from inner model to outer observation boundary.
beats.motion_curve: Questions reveal in a slow outward sequence; decorative lines dissolve gently rather than collapsing.
beats.camera_action: Hold the wide architecture frame for inspection.
beats.visual_inference: A boundary earns its cost by owning a distinct externally inspectable decision or failure.
beats.evidence_boundary: The video supplies a design criterion, not a measured optimum for layer count.

beats.narration: Intelligence may propose. It cannot promote its own output into a different kind of fact.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the opening command question with the reusable noninheritance rule.
beats.visual_action: The original SQL capsule and transformed patch rest on parallel rails before gold gates; no-promotion stop bars align across the complete stack.
beats.attention_target: the two preserved proposals paused at their matching authority boundaries
beats.object_before: The stack test is visible but the two concrete cases are no longer paired.
beats.object_after: Warehouse command and security patch share one noninheritance structure without merging their domain identities.
beats.composition: Two case rails balance left and right inside the wide stack, with a clear center stop and empty lower caption band.
beats.motion_curve: Objects return through matching paths, settle once, and remain still for the final frame.
beats.camera_action: Static final tableau with no end-card intrusion during the spoken payoff.
beats.visual_inference: No component may promote its own output into authority, effect, or observed reality.
beats.evidence_boundary: The closing rule remains a normative architecture claim at argument support.
